notes.subject: long Yisrael
notes.rationale: ves i toktok wantaim ol man Yisrael — yupela

notes.subject: ol dispela samting
notes.rationale: summarizing ol namba bilong olgeta ofa long olgeta feast

translation: Ol dispela samting yupela i wokim long Yahwe long ol taim bilong ol feast bilong yupela, long hapsait long ol promis bilong yupela na ol samting yupela givim long laik bilong yupela — long ol ofa bilong paia bilong yupela, na ol minkha bilong yupela, na ol wara-kapsait ofa bilong yupela, na ol ofa bilong pis bilong yupela.
